ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) to 80-85% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity regions located at the distal lobe tips. Left lobe tip contains a singular, roughly elliptical white blob with sparse internal low-intensity mottling. Right lobe tip contains a white blob segmented into at least three distinct segments by dark linear pixel bands.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, wide-angle U-shaped depression at the center-point with an estimated interior angle of 125 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entirety of the posterior boundary; peaks and valleys range from 2-5 pixels in depth relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending to the lateral tips, with a slight increase in slope at the outer distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Granular, high-contrast pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of roughly parallel, low-intensity linear disruptions crossing diagonally through the high-intensity patch on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rake-mark scarring appearing as dark linear incisions on the white pigmentation of the right lobe.
